# Advisories govulncheck reports that do not apply, one per line:
#   ID  module  version  # why
# An entry covers that exact version only — upgrading or downgrading the module
# brings the advisory back for review. Remove an entry once the vulnerability
# database is corrected or the module has moved on.

# xDS server panic on requests without :authority/Host. The fix (#9365) was
# cherry-picked to v1.84.x as #9370 before v1.84.0 was tagged and is in the
# released code (internal/transport/http2_server.go rejects such requests), but
# the advisory lists only 1.85.0-dev as fixed for the 1.84 line. mddb does not
# use xDS either.
GO-2026-6443 google.golang.org/grpc v1.84.0  # fix #9365 shipped in v1.84.0 via #9370; vulndb range omits it; no xDS in mddb
